notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rIhBwODRtAI;full][/previewyoutube]


This demo includes both the new mouse mode and the VR mode as well. Any feedback is appreciated!

notes.title: So Far Up Mouse Mode!
notes.content:
Rejoice non-VR players! This game just got its new game mode, you can now play this game on a flatscreen using a mouse without a VR headset ! Somehow the mouse mode is harder than the VR mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459817/de9e68a0d89ca5323cfe2ea6f911951a2c955570.gif[/img]

Use your mouse to move forward and overcome obstacles.

Stay tuned for the demo!
